purpose: Calibrate a local Qwen-VL judge as the ONLY RL reward (no R0/LPIPS/MAE in reward or selection); goal: RL beats released RT-1 SFT50k.
data: rt1_memspo200_upstream_20261017 validation split (32 windows). Not RL training windows, not test.
candidates: SFT, MemSPO group beam 4x2, horizon 10, diversity 0.1; R0-RL candidates are a diagnostic only
judge: pointwise, GT-referenced, aligned REFERENCE/PREDICTION per timestamp, both presentation orders averaged; expected digit level over 0-4 from logits; weights structure 0.2 dynamics 0.4 interaction 0.4
tie_rule: tau = tie_multiplier * median |order0 - order1| over SFT candidates; a group with max-min spread <= tau is a tie (zero advantage) in RL
diagnostics_not_gates: R0-RL minus SFT window mean score

selection_rule.written: 2026-10-19, after dev_8b_s1/dev_8b_s2, before dev_4b_s2 results were read
selection_rule.dev: validation cases 0-15; candidates 8B scale1, 8B scale2, 4B scale2
selection_rule.rule: among configs passing all gates on dev, pick highest within_group_spearman_order0_vs_order1; ties (<0.05) broken by faster config
selection_rule.confirm: run the selected config unchanged on held-out validation cases 16-31; it must pass all gates again; tau for RL = that confirm run's tau
